items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I want to study Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Was there a point that you said to yourself and maybe to your parents or your family that I think I’m going to make a career of this?

Yeah. Well first of all I had to stop playing the clarinet. Because the kids, well they were about 17, 18 and I was like maybe 15, 14, 16 you know. Say “Wendell, Benny Goodman is all right, they’ve got a young baby boy that’s trying to beat Benny Goodman. You need to listen to Charlie Parker if you want to play.” Because I was surprised he could play real fast tempos, man they could really play, and one guy sounded like a carbon copy of Dizzy Gillespie and Chuck. Charles McPherson was sounding exactly like Bird…
What would the song list have been like? And do you recall how much money you first made? Your first gig? Your first paying gig?
